title: Remedy, restoration, system revision, and survivor-conditioned learning

observations.claim: NLRB public records include remedies such as reinstatement, backpay, restoration of positions and removal of adverse personnel records.
limits: Procedural posture and remedy vary by case.

observations.claim: California, New York and Minnesota warehouse regimes make quota descriptions, work-speed data or complaints addressable before and after adverse action.
ICO guidance requires correction, challenge and non-disadvantage for workers seeking manual intervention, with rapid restoration in access-control examples.
The Platform Work Directive requires explanation, competent human contact, review, rectification or compensation, and steps to avoid recurrence including system modification or discontinuation.
The Directive requires regular impact evaluation with worker-representative involvement and protects human overseers from adverse treatment for exercising their role.
Worker and representative participation can expose errors that a validation population limited to retained and compliant workers would otherwise miss.
limits: Bounded synthesis; no quantified universal effect.

findings.claim: A remedy should restore future optionality by correcting access, pay, duties, personnel records and explanation—not merely acknowledge that the process failed.
An upheld challenge is system evidence: the institution should revise the threshold, feature, workflow or model and retain the change rather than treating the case as an isolated exception.
limits: Protocol synthesis; no universal legal duty claimed.

findings.claim: Validation on retained, silent or compliant workers remains selection-conditioned because exits, overturned cases, reinstatements and people deterred from speaking are absent from the apparent success population.
limits: No quantified false-negative or suppression rate.

findings.claim: Counterpower is measurable by whether a worker or representative can change the immediate decision and force correction of the system that produced it.
